semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in ultra-high-end semiconductor manufacturing and packaging equipment.
summary: Precision Electronic Technology (Suzhou) Co., Ltd. designs and manufactures advanced semiconductor manufacturing and packaging equipment, including high-speed wire bonding and die bonding machines. The company is recognized as a national high-tech enterprise and focuses on innovation in high-precision equipment technologies.

regional_presence.China: The company is located in Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, where it focuses on production and sales.
